items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: Then his daughter came, Benji, who was a lovely girl, and I picked them up and brought him from the airport and all that sort of stuff.

ctx.x: Chico Hamilton, good. Yeah. Chico. And she knew Chico. So we hung out. So now it’s about three in the morning, so she said, “Let’s go back to my place.” How am I going to handle this? What kind of a time am I going to have with Ava Gardner? The first thing she did, she walks in her apartment, or house it was, she put on Duke, and she’s dancing to Duke. So now it’s getting kind of late after about two hours, the maid comes down and joins us. And she said, “Oh, it’s getting to be bedtime.” And I said, “Ava, I have…

eyes, that would scare the hell out of the devil. Anyway he said, “Where have you been for the last 36 hours?” I said, “I went up to Grimsby to visit.” He said, “Well the last time I saw you you were leaving with Ava Gardner.” I said, “No. I was there a good part of the night,” I said, “but I left and went on the train up to Grimsby to visit some relatives.” He said, “Don’t you ever leave this tour without me knowing exactly where you are.” And walked away. So I turned to Muriel and I said, “Muriel, what was that…
